Reference image for the [[Anagrams]] row on [[Gela Yeens]], whose title is an anagram of Angel Eyes: Angel Eyes (Lee Van Cleef) in ''The Good, the Bad and the Ugly'' (1966), from the final standoff.

Source: a frame at 0:02:27 of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IFNUGzCOQoI The Good, The Bad, and the Ugly (1966) | Official Trailer | MGM Studios], Amazon MGM Studios, YouTube.
